nodes.question: What are the potential social impacts of AI on rural communities as highlighted in the paper?
nodes.answer: The paper indicates that AI-driven systems and digital communication are contributing to broader social changes in rural communities, leading to the decline of traditional social spaces and impacting community cohesion and mental well-being.
